screenshots.notes: The opening view of Leonida Platinum: a dense three-column board with the trophy checklist on the left, the step-by-step guide for trophy 28 in the middle, and a sources rail on the right. Twelve of the fifty-five trophies show as earned, the guide for trophy 28 lists its five cited steps with a meditation counter reading 6 of 18, the audit strip at the top reads 282/282 claims cited and 117/117 steps cited, and the sources rail shows each source with its guide and step tallies.
screenshots.title: Cover — three-column trophy board, 282/282 claims cited

screenshots.notes: The detail view for trophy 28 while the spoiler shield is switched on with the visible toggle button. Hidden trophies stay covered in the list so their names and descriptions cannot be read, yet the guide for trophy 28 itself remains fully readable, including its numbered cited steps, the per-trophy claims-cited line, the missable warning, and its cited sources.
screenshots.title: Guide view — trophy 28 with spoiler shield on

screenshots.notes: The platinum roadmap screen: a Next Up list of the trophies to chase first, followed by six stage cards laid out in two columns showing progress through each stage and the number of cited steps in each stage. A banner at the top warns about the missable trophy so the player does not lose it by playing past the point of no return.
screenshots.title: Platinum roadmap — next steps and six stages

screenshots.notes: The checklist narrowed to missable trophies only, with the spoiler shield still active. The sticky filter bar stays on screen while scrolled down: Missable only is checked, the spoiler toggle reads ON, and the guide for trophy 28 shows its 5/5 cited steps with the meditation counter at 6 of 18. The footer export and import controls are visible at the bottom of the same frame.
screenshots.title: Missable-only filter with spoiler shield on and export visible
